item.title: Vishay power resistors push density to 650 W
item.summary: Vishay Intertechnology has introduced the RPWA 650 series of thick film power resistors, delivering up to 650 W of continuous power in a compact, low-profile package. The devices combine high power handling with customizable cabling and optional temperature sensing to reduce component count and simplify assembly.
